title: Welcome
body:
# Welcome

This is your notepad. Everything you type is **saved automatically** to this browser — nothing is sent anywhere.

## Markdown you can use

- **bold**, *italic*, `inline code`
- Headings with `#`, `##`, `###`
- Lists (like this one) and numbered lists
- > Block quotes
- [Links](https://example.com)

```
fenced code blocks too
```

Make a new note with **+ New note** on the left.
